findings: Osaka city per-capita levy calculated for each ward and then totaled; Tokyo principal-ward combined prefectural/city handling must not be reused.

City corporation-tax levy rate depends on registered capital and nationwide preallocation levy base; eligible capital<=JPY100m and full-year base<=JPY20m use6%,otherwise8.2%. Liquidation and tax-trust exclusions require explicit handling.
Per-capita capital uses adjusted statutory capital with capital-plus-reserve floor; not registered capital alone.
City levy base precedes specified national credits; national final tax is not an interchangeable base.

Verify filing rounding and short-year allocation in original return instructions.
Bind office/ward facts, local adjustments and component prepayments to saved national calculation.
Implement API/UI/report and restart/browser acceptance; Osaka is not nationwide Japan completion.
